questions.question: Which personality traits do you want your colleagues to have? For example, trustworthiness, efficient communication, or friendliness.
questions.reference_answer: I would like my colleagues to have three main traits. The first one is trustworthiness. In a team, people rely on each other to finish shared goals, and trust is the foundation of that cooperation. When my colleagues keep their promises and handle sensitive information responsibly, I can focus on my own work without worrying. The second trait is efficient communication. Work moves faster when people state their ideas clearly, listen carefully, and give feedback in a timely way. For example, when a deadline is approaching, a brief update can save the whole team from misunderstandings and rework. The last trait is friendliness. A friendly attitude makes the workplace comfortable, and it encourages people to ask for help and share ideas openly. When colleagues are kind and supportive, small problems are solved quickly before they become big ones. In short, trustworthiness builds the foundation, efficient communication speeds up the work, and friendliness makes the team a pleasant place to be.
questions.keywords: which personality traits do you want your colleagues to have for example
